#!/bin/bash
# 全面文件盘点脚本

echo "=========================================="
echo "满意解研究所 - 全文件盘点"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

WORKSPACE="/root/.openclaw/workspace"

echo "📊 按目录统计："
echo "------------------------------------------"

# 根目录文件
echo -n "根目录 (.md): "
find $WORKSPACE -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l

echo -n "根目录 (.py): "
find $WORKSPACE -maxdepth 1 -name "*.py" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l

echo -n "根目录 (.json): "
find $WORKSPACE -maxdep
